claims.claim: Fernhaven Cycles, an independent bike shop in Providence, sells the Torrent 800 headlamp at $25.00, and owner Sam Whitaker sets all prices.
claims.source: Shop price list and ownership record

claims.claim: Point-of-sale records show the shop sold the Torrent 800 at a steady 12 units per day from 15 June through the 17 July close.
Point-of-sale records show $5,100 of Torrent 800 revenue for 1 July through the 17 July close, from 204 units at $25.00.
Pedal & Spoke, the only other retailer of the Torrent 800 in the shop's market, posted the lamp at $19.99 on the morning of 18 July with signage stating the summer clearance runs through 31 August.

During March 2026, when Pedal & Spoke priced the Torrent 800 at $19.50 against Fernhaven's $25.00 for three weeks, Fernhaven's sales of the lamp ran at 7 units per day for the duration and returned to 12 per day once prices matched.
Whitaker's documented practice is to review and change prices only on the first business day of each month, and he has stated he does not make mid-month price changes.
claims.source: Shop pricing memo and owner interview

claims.claim: The shop is open every day from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM with no closures scheduled through 31 July.
The shop holds over 400 Torrent 800 units in stock.
Fourteen selling days remain in July, 18 through 31 July inclusive.
claims.source: Derived from the calendar and posted shop hours

claims.claim: Whitaker has stated he is prepared to match the clearance price at his 3 August monthly review if it is still in force.
